completed: Committed the P0.0 repair and merged origin/main (69 commits) into p0-0-universal-routing, then merged that branch into local main. Nothing pushed.

Implemented P0.1: workflow manifest schema (schemas/workflow-manifest-v1.schema.json), provider-neutral capability layer (src/agent_os/capabilities.py), and the staged orchestrator (src/agent_os/workflows.py).

Stage lifecycle: deterministic stages execute and validate locally; other stages are prepared with their own budgeted context, a recommended capability class, and an exact next prompt, then handed to the running agent.

Escalation is evidence-driven: one rung per failed validator, bounded by max_escalations, with the reason recorded. A passed stage is never re-run or silently promoted, and partial outputs survive a failure.
Exposed the orchestrator through 7 CLI commands and 7 MCP tools, so every routed surface from P0.0 can drive a staged run. Manifests and run records are now checked by agent.py validate.

Added tests/test_workflows.py: 46 regression tests covering manifest validation, ordering, restart/idempotency, checkpoints, escalation and non-escalation, per-stage budgets, transcript-free state, next-prompt generation, provider neutrality, and writeback safety.
Documented the design in docs/staged-workflows.md and recorded carried-forward debt separately in projects/personal-agent-os/roadmap/technical-debt.md.
decisions: The orchestrator prepares model stages but never executes them; automatic delegation belongs with P1.3 because that spend is separately billed.
Provider neutrality is enforced on the orchestrator core and manifests only. The P0.0 surface registry names vendors on purpose, so the whole repository is not a meaningful target for that check.
A deterministic stage must declare a real validator; an unverifiable deterministic stage is just an unverified stage wearing a cheaper label.
Staging is not claimed as a raw context reduction. It measured 3125 staged tokens against 2536 for one unstaged pass; the test bounds the total rather than asserting a saving.
remaining: P0.1 work is uncommitted; the user asked for no commit without approval.
cache and skill execution paths are recorded but not yet dispatched differently from model; depends on P0.3.
Stage ordering is linear, with no conditional or parallel branching.
No per-stage telemetry yet; capability selection is policy-driven rather than evidence-driven. P1.1 covers it.
Next roadmap item is P0.2 selective context and profile retrieval.
